text: | | Amount debited, plan not credited, 1-24 hours elapsed | Acknowledgement delayed beyond the typical window | Continue waiting; auto-reversal triggers automatically at 24 hours if it's not resolved by then | | 24+ hours elapsed, no credit and no reversal | Acknowledgement never reached NovaTel's system | Raise a ticket with the transaction reference | ### Escalation Raising a ticket with the transaction reference is the documented next step once the 24-hour auto-reversal window has passed without resolution. ### Example Scenario **Customer situation:** A customer recharged 90 minutes ago and the bank shows the debit, but the plan hasn't credited yet. **What happens:** Since this is still within the typical 30-60 minute to a few hours window, waiting is the recommended action before raising a ticket. ### Related Information Related documents referenced in NovaTel's internal metadata for this topic: KB_C03_overview. title: Why did my recharge fail even though the amount was debited?
